text: Annual leave is charged for Monday through Friday inclusive. Weekends are excluded. Public holidays are not modeled in this workshop. A request must fit the available balance and requires manager approval.
Employees may carry forward up to 5 unused annual leave days into the next year.
Monthly payroll is scheduled for the last working day of the month. The payroll lookup returns the synthetic current pay record.
Employees may work remotely up to 2 days per week with manager agreement.
